title: VerifiedMemoryItem
description: Defines an accepted reusable project capability, not merely stored text. Speculative notes must not use this schema.

what_is_known.description: The precise capability, configuration, or fact that was proven.

why_is_it_believed.description: The deterministic evidence, test script, or logs that prove it.

applicable_state.description: The exact commit, artifact hash, or system state where this was true.

producer_identity.description: The agent, worker, or human who ran the verification.

invalidation_conditions.description: Specific conditions that would render this memory obsolete.
